disabled.title: Evaluation is off
disabled.description: Observability is disabled for this deployment, so datasets cannot be built from runs.

empty.title: No dataset versions yet
empty.description: Save a reviewed case from a run, or add a reviewed synthetic example, to create the first frozen version.

forbidden.title: You cannot manage this dataset
forbidden.description: Datasets follow the Bot's management rights. Reuse across Bots needs an explicit authorized copy.

basic.title: Metrics-only source
basic.description: The source run recorded metrics only. It cannot become a text sample; supply a reviewed synthetic or redacted example instead.

omitted.title: Content omitted
omitted.description: This field could not be handled safely, so only metrics are shown. Omitted is not the same as empty.

truncated.title: Content truncated
truncated.description: This value exceeds the recorded size limit and was cut. A frozen version keeps the truncated value as saved.

syncing.title: Version still syncing
syncing.description: The version was accepted locally but is not confirmed upstream yet. Syncing is not success.

unavailable.title: Upstream unavailable
unavailable.description: The observability store did not answer, so this version cannot be read right now. Nothing was deleted.

page.title: Datasets
page.description: Reviewed cases from this Bot's recorded runs, frozen as immutable dataset versions.

list.title: Datasets
list.description: One row per dataset this Bot holds, with its frozen version count.

save.rowTitle: Save a case from a run
save.rowDescription: Pick one case from this Bot's run history, review what the redaction policy will freeze, then save it as a dataset version. The run id comes from the run observability page.
save.dialogDescription: Reviewing projects the case once and shows exactly what a save would freeze. Nothing is stored until you save.
save.canary_one: {{count}} case came back with parts the redaction policy refused. Those parts freeze as omitted, never as typed.
save.canary_other: {{count}} cases came back with parts the redaction policy refused. Those parts freeze as omitted, never as typed.
save.fixturesInvalid: Tool fixtures must be a JSON object.
save.incomplete: The run id, dataset name, case input and reference output all need content first.
save.mustReview: Preview the freeze first; editing anything afterwards clears the preview.
save.savedNew: Frozen as a new version of “{{name}}”: {{hash}}
save.savedReplay: This exact content was already saved. The existing version of “{{name}}” was returned unchanged: {{hash}}. Nothing new was created.

version.title: Frozen versions
version.description: Each version is an immutable snapshot: projected once, hashed, never editable. Saving different cases creates a new version; the previous ones stand.

detail.noVersions: This dataset holds no frozen version yet.

error.CASE_REVIEW_RUN_NOT_FOUND: This Bot's records hold no run with that id. Nothing was saved.
error.CASE_REVIEW_INPUT_INVALID: The case is not valid: every field needs content, a given attempt id must match the run's latest attempt, and fixtures must be a JSON object.
error.DATASET_INPUT_INVALID: The dataset name or the case is not valid. Nothing was saved.
error.DATASET_NOT_FOUND: This dataset does not exist in this Bot's scope.
error.unreachable: The observability store did not answer. Nothing was saved.
